thread:
**Issue #4601 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4601: Patch: the Infinite Assault, the cards, IA-25 to IA-240 (fullsend)
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

Part of #4576. **The cards, as one fullsend tree**: the Infinite Assault's cards IA-25 to IA-240 (the
eight doctrines and the twelve Commanders, 216 cards and 13 tokens), built in parallel and reconciled into one
pull request into `main`. C1 (#4577) builds the set itself and IA-1 to IA-24 on `main` first.

The plan of record is [`docs/infinite-assault.md`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/claude/gallant-ritchie-pwshvk/docs/infinite-assault.md): on `main` once C1 (#4577) merges, and until then on the planning branch `claude/gallant-ritchie-pwshvk`. Where it and SPEC disagree, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). Its IA11 and IA12 are this tree's scope.

**Why a tree.** The cards were a chain of nine pull requests, one at a time, since each added rows to the same
shared files. Here the foundation (CF) writes every entry and every shared row once, with a stub script per card,
as Stinkyscape+'s foundation did (#3535, in #3596): then each card part touches only its own cards' script files,
so the nine build side by side, a strong model planning each and any subscription building it from the plan
(`bot/README.md`, Fullsend), and the reconcile runs the checks once.

**Its parts** (its sub-issues, opened by hand; the bot adopts them):

| Part | Owns | Blocked by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CF, the card foundation | every shared row of IA-25 to IA-240 and their tokens: the catalog entries with both faces, the census, the fixture rows, the radiant-audit rows, `card-text.yaml`, `card-audio.json5`, the FX lines, §8.13's rows, a stub script per entry | — |
| C2 Hallucination … C9 Singularity, C10 the Commanders | their own cards' script files, their entries' `loc`, their own rows where the build decides otherwise | CF |

**When it starts.** It is labelled `bot:fullsend` once C1 has merged, so its integration branch,
`bot/issue-<this issue>`, is cut from a `main` that holds the set's row, its hold and its tags.

## Done when (the reconcile)

- Every card of IA-25 to IA-240 plays its base and Radiant faces by its §8.13 row, with its tests in its own
  file (CLAUDE.md rule 6); no stub is left (`STUB (#<CF>)` appears nowhere).
- Every new prompt is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout; `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200
  --cards "Infinite Assault"`, `catalog check`, `spec check`, `names --check` and the workspace tests are green,
  with the set still held: nothing changes for players, and no golden trace moves.
- The pull request into `main` merges with `rust`, `web`, `e2e smoke`, `db` and `bot selftest` green
  (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

Blocked by #4577


---

```
